Question B-003-002-002.

Why the correct answer is right: A microphone transduces changing air pressure from speech into an electrical audio signal.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "is quieter than AM or SSB microphones": Quietness compared with other microphones is not the defining transmitter-block function being tested.
- sourceIndex 2: "has a different tone than other microphones": Tone quality can vary among microphones, but the block-diagram job is conversion from sound pressure to electrical audio.
- sourceIndex 3: "has a wider frequency range than other microphones": Bandwidth differences among microphones are design details; all of these voice microphones serve the same basic transducer role.
